edges.action: add application domain in an environment

evidence.result: A generated application domain is submitted and the success toast is visible.
The Staging environment is added and appears on the project environments page.
The create-project wizard is submitted, the browser lands on its environments route, and tenantGroupId is captured from the URL.

edges.action: delete the project created by this run

evidence.result: Each environment is deleted and the created project name is absent from the console.

edges.action: create a new email communication, basic information step

evidence.result: Step 1 (Basic information) of the New Communication wizard is submitted and persists server-side, advancing the wizard to the Template design step. Step 2 (the BeePlugin WYSIWYG template body editor) is not covered by this test.

evidence.result: The project name is changed, the change persists across a page reload, and the name is reverted to its original value at the end of the test.

edges.action: register a service in My Services

evidence.result: A service named Test Service is saved and its service card with a Logs link is visible.

edges.action: add or update a captcha configuration

evidence.result: A captcha configuration (site key + secret key) is saved and the success toast appears; falls back to editing an existing configuration when both providers are already configured on the test project.

assertions: OAuth client credentials for service-to-service access
evidence.result: The Add Client Credential dialog is submitted with only the required client name, the success toast appears, and the new credential's name is visible in the list.

edges.action: add an external IdP certificate via URL

evidence.result: An external IdP certificate is registered via the 'Others' provider (which skips real JWKS validation) with a dummy URL, and the success toast appears.
A notification configuration is saved and the success toast appears, and the new configuration's name is visible in the list.
An SFTP storage configuration is saved with dummy host/port/credential values and the success toast appears.
An OIDC client is created with a dummy HTTPS redirect URI, the success toast appears, and the new client's name is visible in the list.

edges.action: toggle an MFA provider and revert

evidence.result: The first MFA provider's Enable/Disable state is flipped through the confirmation modal, the status badge updates accordingly, and the state is toggled back to its original value at the end of the test.
